title: Use Seedance to naturally blend DIYUSI with ネクデカ in a single video while…
content: Use Seedance to naturally blend DIYUSI with ネクデカ in a single video while keeping the character singing with eyes closed (avoiding the “eyes open” issue seen in DomoAI lip-sync even when prompted to forbid it).
tips: Use Seedance to naturally blend DIYUSI with ネクデカ in a single video while keeping the character singing with eyes closed (avoiding the “eyes open” issue seen in DomoAI lip-sync even when prompted to forbid it).

en.content: Use Seedance to naturally blend DIYUSI with Nekdeka in a single video while keeping the character singing with eyes closed, avoiding the “eyes open” issue seen in DomoAI lip-sync even when prompted to forbid it.

es.content: Usa Seedance para fusionar de forma natural DIYUSI con ネクデカ en un solo video, manteniendo al personaje cantando con los ojos cerrados (evitando el problema de “ojos abiertos” que se ve en el lip-sync de DomoAI incluso cuando se indica explícitamente que no ocurra).

fr.content: Utilisez Seedance pour fusionner naturellement DIYUSI avec ネクデカ dans une seule vidéo, tout en gardant le personnage en train de chanter les yeux fermés (en évitant le problème des « yeux ouverts » observé dans le lip-sync de DomoAI, même lorsqu’on lui demande explicitement de l’interdire).

ko.content: Seedance를 사용해 DIYUSI와 ネクデカ를 하나의 영상에서 자연스럽게 결합하면서, 캐릭터가 눈을 감은 채 노래하도록 유지하세요(눈을 뜨지 않도록 지시해도 DomoAI 립싱크에서 보이던 “눈 뜸” 문제를 피하면서).

pt.content: Use o Seedance para mesclar naturalmente DIYUSI com ネクデカ em um único vídeo, mantendo o personagem cantando de olhos fechados (evitando o problema de “olhos abertos” visto no lip-sync do DomoAI, mesmo quando instruído a proibi-lo).

zh.content: 使用 Seedance 将 DIYUSI 与 ネクデカ 自然融合到同一个视频中，同时保持角色闭眼唱歌（避免即使在提示中禁止，DomoAI lip-sync 仍会出现的“睁眼”问题）。
